title: Tir na n-og
html_source: Tír na nÓg is a paradisaical land of everlasting youth from Celtic mythology, featuring prominently in the tale of Oisín and Niamh).

anchor.prefix: ats. Cypherjugglers going the highroads. Seekers on the great quest. What town, good masters? Mummed in names: A. E., eon: Magee, John Eglinton. East of the sun, west of the moon:
anchor.suffix:
. Booted the twain and staved. 

How many miles to Dublin?
Three score and ten, sir. 
Will we be there by candlelight?
